I lead the twice-weekly lab and problem sessions that accompany the professor's lectures: I work through the theory with students, write the R code for each topic, and build case studies on real data so the methods are learned on questions that matter. Since 2023 I have assisted in **13 course sections** with about **360 enrolled students**.

## Courses

| Subject (UNAM name) | Sections | What the course covers | Material |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Probability II** (*Probabilidad II*) | 1 | Joint distributions, transformations of random vectors, conditional expectation, generating functions, limit theorems | — |
| **Statistical Inference** (*Inferencia Estadística*) | 3 | Sampling distributions, point estimation and maximum likelihood, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing | [Case study: pedestrian crashes in Mexico City](https://amaugomez.github.io/cdmx-pedestrian-crashes/) · [code](https://github.com/AMauGomez/teaching-notes/tree/main/01-inferencia-estadistica) |
| **Nonparametric and Regression Models** (*Modelos No Paramétricos y de Regresión*) | 3 | Rank and goodness-of-fit tests, contingency tables, simple and multiple linear regression, diagnostics, model selection, ANOVA and ANCOVA | [Case study: mortgage pricing](https://amaugomez.github.io/mortgage-pricing-regression/) · [code](https://github.com/AMauGomez/teaching-notes/tree/main/02-modelos-no-parametricos-y-de-regresion) |
| **Multivariate Analysis** (*Análisis Multivariado*) | 3 | Multivariate normal and Hotelling's T², principal components, factor analysis, correspondence analysis, multidimensional scaling, clustering, discriminant analysis; complementary SVM and k-NN | [code](https://github.com/AMauGomez/teaching-notes/tree/main/04-analisis-multivariado) |
| **Survival and Time Series Models** (*Modelos de Supervivencia y de Series de Tiempo*) | 2 | Censoring, Kaplan–Meier, log-rank, parametric and Cox models; stationarity, smoothing, ARIMA and forecasting | [code](https://github.com/AMauGomez/teaching-notes/tree/main/03-modelos-de-supervivencia-y-series-de-tiempo) · applied in [mortgage credit risk](https://amaugomez.github.io/mortgage-credit-risk/) |
| **Stochastic Simulation** (*Simulación Estocástica*) | 1 | Random variate generation, Monte Carlo integration and variance reduction, MCMC, EM, bootstrap | [code](https://github.com/AMauGomez/teaching-notes/tree/main/05-simulacion-estocastica) · applied in [mortgage credit risk](https://amaugomez.github.io/mortgage-credit-risk/) |

## How I teach

- **One real question per course.** Inference is taught around a single claim tested end to end ([is someone hit by a car every 30 minutes?](https://amaugomez.github.io/cdmx-pedestrian-crashes/)); regression around [whether mortgage brokers charge more](https://amaugomez.github.io/mortgage-pricing-regression/).
- **Check the assumptions before the conclusion.** Every method comes with its diagnostics and with an example where ignoring them gives the wrong answer.
- **Code anyone can rerun.** All material is in R, organised by the official syllabus, in the [teaching-notes repository](https://github.com/AMauGomez/teaching-notes).
